passage:
habit — 习惯
Last year, she had a bad habit.

tired — 疲倦的
She felt tired every morning.

nervous — 紧张的
She drank three cups of coffee a day, so she was very nervous.

routine — 日常安排
In March, Lin changed her routine.

cheaper — 更便宜的
Running is cheaper than the gym, and it is more fun for her.

relaxing — 令人放松的
Yoga is the most relaxing exercise for her.

worry — 担心
Lin says, "I should sleep more and worry less." Her friends say she looks happier now.

important — 重要的
She thinks sleep is the most important thing for health.
